Terms of Service – Simple, Clear, Honest

Welcome to IMRango. We’re here to help you find your bra size with free, private, and accurate calculators. These terms are written in plain language – no legal jargon, no hidden clauses.

By using our website, you agree to these terms. If you don’t agree, please don’t use the site. It’s that simple.

1. What We Offer

IMRango provides free online tools and guides for bra sizing, fitting, and measurement. All calculators, charts, and articles are for informational purposes only.

We don’t sell bras, take commissions, or promote specific brands. We’re an independent resource – here to help, not to sell.

2. Your Privacy Matters

Your measurements, data, and personal information are yours alone.

  • All calculations run locally in your browser.
  • We do not collect, store, or share your measurements.
  • We do not use cookies for tracking (only for basic site functionality and advertising).

For more details, check our Privacy Policy.

3. Free & Unrestricted

Everything on IMRango is free to use.

  • No sign-ups
  • No paywalls
  • No hidden fees
  • No data collection

You can use our calculators as many times as you like, for any purpose.

4. What You Can Do

You are welcome to:

  • Use our calculators for personal, non-commercial purposes
  • Share links to our pages with friends and family
  • Link to our site from your blog, social media, or website
  • Give feedback and suggest improvements

We appreciate your support!

5. What You Cannot Do

Please don’t:

  • Copy or reproduce our calculators or content for commercial use
  • Claim our work as your own
  • Use our site for any illegal or harmful activity
  • Overload our servers with automated requests
  • Attempt to hack, bypass, or interfere with our site

We built IMRango with care – please respect that.

6. Accuracy & Limitations

We do our best to provide accurate, up-to-date sizing information. However:

  • Size estimates are not guaranteed – individual fit varies by brand, style, and body shape.
  • Calculators are a starting point – always try on bras for the best fit.
  • We are not responsible for purchases made based on our estimates.

We recommend checking multiple sizes and trying on bras in person when possible.

7. Medical Disclaimer

IMRango is a measurement resource, not a medical service.

  • We do not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
  • If you have concerns about breast health, chest pain, or any medical condition, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.
  • Our calculators are not a substitute for professional medical guidance.

Your health and safety are important – please make informed decisions.

8. Advertising & Affiliates

We may display ads on our site to keep the calculators free. We do not accept paid sponsorships or commissions from bra brands for content.

All ads are clearly marked, and they do not influence our calculators or guides.

9. Changes to These Terms

We may update these terms occasionally to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements.

The latest version will always be posted at this URL. We encourage you to check back periodically.

10. Contact Us

Have questions about these terms? We’re happy to help.

📧 info@iamrango.com

We’ll reply within 24–48 hours.
